title: Concatenation law for program execution
statement: For any instruction-kind type, function $F$ assigning a Boolean-list function to each kind, input list $x$, instruction lists $p,q$, and initial list of Boolean blocks, executing the concatenated program $p$ followed by $q$ yields the same list of blocks as first executing $p$ and then executing $q$ from the resulting state.
